scope: warm native InferenceEngine serving baseline, not optimized/fused/HTTP throughput

hardware.nvidia_smi: NVIDIA B300 SXM6 AC, GPU-dadf9f3b-df58-d3fa-07b0-5fe223423db1, 580.126.09, 275040 MiB

measurement.ttft: submit to first asyncio stream token; includes queueing
measurement.tpot: mean inter-token arrival interval per request, excludes first token
measurement.prefill_throughput: input_tokens/TTFT; effective serving rate, not isolated kernel prefill throughput
measurement.decode_throughput: (output_tokens-1)/(last-first); per request, do not sum to obtain aggregate throughput
measurement.memory: device-wide 100ms sampled peak, includes native allocations; not exact allocator high-water mark
